reason: Prior tests found no repeatable gain from sixteen panel32 calls, 272-byte A-slice padding, or the measured K-loop schedules. The top proposals make distinct, full-kernel layout or traversal changes that may improve reuse, but cache benefits remain hypotheses and correctness risk is material. Panel64 needs a new validated helper before it is feasible. Prefetching and transpose fusion have uncertain cost; the 256-step K-loop proposals need source confirmation because the supplied full512 loops show 512 iterations, not a two-K body. Alignment has no demonstrated failure, and general-fallback transpose fusion does not address n=512. No proposal has evidence of reaching 1800 GFLOP/s.
